comment: Independent external review (VR-007). For each hypothesis of the audited theorem that VR-006 classed as discharged: on which parallel theorems it is absent, what stands in its place there, and the relation. Reviewer's reading of the lane documents; the consistency check verifies the names only.

entries.note: T, Ux, Xx and pr are auxiliary objects that the conclusion never mentions; the three theorems fix them (T := ebT, pr := gP) and prove these facts. No hypothesis takes their place.

the verdict link is exchanged for a condition on the statement check (finding L55-1) and two conditions on the stage families

Lb ≤ 26 follows there from hPk, which says the block profiles are the Shieldstral run's (ShieldRunAt Pk Rp.blks Lb); an instance fact exchanged for another instance fact

audited_refinement_conditions.note: conditions that the audited theorem's finer stage hypotheses (lanes L53, L57) bring with them; the three other theorems carry the coarser stage hypotheses and so need none of these. Classified bookkeeping or instance data in classification-normalized.tsv.
